operation.summary: Turn spending on or off for the namespace: the pause, per instrument class and per source. Off applies at once; nothing here changes today's live budgets; explicit owner.configuration grant required

body.name: namespace
body.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build

body.name: paused
body.description: true pauses every spend of the namespace

body.name: classes
body.description: Instrument class to true or false, for example {"metered": false}

body.name: sources
body.description: Source id to true or false

body.name: generation
body.description: The rule document generation this change replaces (from a read); a change against an older one is refused with conflict. Left out, the current one is used

operation.returns: the same as GET, plus changed
